story.title: The Memory Broker
story.logline: A woman who deletes traumatic memories for a living accidentally removes the memory of falling in love, only to realize her client is the man she promised to never forget.
story.twist: The client whose painful memory she just deleted is her own husband, whom she chose to forget yesterday.
story.ending: If love leaves no scar, was it ever real?

scenes.narration: I erase bad memories for a living, but today’s client broke my absolute rule.
scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of Elena, a 30-year-old woman with messy dark hair and a silver lab coat, sitting in a sleek neon-lit clinic, looking intensely at a glowing glass vial.

scenes.narration: He slid a heavy gold coin across my desk and whispered, 'Take away the worst day of my life.'
scenes.visual_prompt: Elena, 30-year-old woman with messy dark hair and a silver lab coat, in the sleek neon-lit clinic, looking across a metal desk at a shadowy figure.

scenes.narration: I plugged the silver extraction needle into his temple. The glowing blue memory thread flooded my screen.
scenes.visual_prompt: Elena, 30-year-old woman with messy dark hair and a silver lab coat, in the sleek neon-lit clinic, operating a glowing holographic machine connected to a chair.

scenes.narration: Bright sunlight, crashing ocean waves, and laughter. Wait, this isn't trauma. This is pure joy.
scenes.visual_prompt: Elena, 30-year-old woman with messy dark hair and a silver lab coat, staring wide-eyed at a floating holographic screen showing a sunny beach.

scenes.narration: Before I could pull the needle out, the memory surged forward and flooded my own neural implant.
scenes.visual_prompt: Elena, 30-year-old woman with messy dark hair and a silver lab coat, clutching her head as blue light reflects in her eyes in the clinic.

scenes.narration: I saw myself laughing on that beach, wearing a wedding ring, promising this exact stranger forever.
scenes.visual_prompt: Elena, 30-year-old woman with messy dark hair and a silver lab coat, seeing a holographic projection of herself smiling on a beach.

scenes.narration: The machine beeped. The extraction was complete. He opened his eyes and looked at me like a total stranger.
scenes.visual_prompt: Elena, 30-year-old woman with messy dark hair and a silver lab coat, watching a man wake up blank-faced in the clinic chair.

scenes.narration: 'Who are you?' he asked politely, standing up and leaving the heavy gold coin on my desk.
scenes.visual_prompt: Elena, 30-year-old woman with messy dark hair and a silver lab coat, sitting alone at her metal desk in the quiet clinic.

scenes.narration: I reached for my own journal to figure out why I did this, but the pages were completely blank.
scenes.visual_prompt: Elena, 30-year-old woman with messy dark hair and a silver lab coat, flipping through empty paper pages under a desk lamp.

scenes.narration: I erased the pain of losing him, but in doing so, I lost him twice. If love leaves no scar, was it ever real?
scenes.visual_prompt: Elena, 30-year-old woman with messy dark hair and a silver lab coat, staring blankly into a dark mirror in the empty clinic.

caption.hook: She deleted his memory. Then she wept.
caption.title: The Memory Broker
caption.caption:
She thought erasing the pain was a mercy, scrubbing away the scars of a shattered heart. But as the anesthesia fades, she looks into her client's eyes and realizes the terrible truth: she just erased the only man she swore to love.

Would you give up your greatest love to escape your deepest pain?
